complaint_subject: Complaint regarding Overflowing Garbage Bin at Indiranagar 12th Main
complaint_body:
To,
The Assistant Executive Engineer (SWM) / Junior Health Inspector,
Ward 89, BBMP East Zone, Bengaluru.

Subject: Urgent clearance of overflowing garbage bin at Indiranagar 12th Main

Respected Sir/Madam,

I am writing to draw your urgent attention to an uncollected garbage accumulation at 12th Main Road, near Indiranagar Club. The waste bin has been overflowing for over three days, and refuse is scattered over the footpath.

Kindly dispatch a sanitary vehicle to clear the waste and sanitize the spot with disinfectant powder.

Thank you,
Concerned Citizen, Indiranagar Residents Welfare Association
